analysis:
The change is documentation only, in docs/architecture/inference.md. The patch excerpt was truncated, so I reviewed the supplied head text for lines 397-1207. Those lines contain mostly unchanged prose. The changed ranges that fall in this window are 911-919, 937, and 948-968. They cover local HTTP reasoning-parser selection, the ReasoningPromptProbe/contentSeed behavior, and a link to the Responses continuation and retention docs. The edits are descriptive and add no code. They do not alter any control relevant to T-041 or to the TB-002, TB-003, TB-007 or TB-011 boundaries.

T-041 (prefix cache) is the only threat definition supplied in full. The text I reviewed still matches it. Prefix-cache identity does not include the sampler. The doc says the sampler is not part of the prompt or cache identity, and that statement is consistent with T-041's account of how cache scope is derived. Vision requests are described as never staging SSD blocks. The doc mentions the 30-minute TTL nowhere in this window, so no TTL drift is visible here.

Doc claims I could not verify, because no source was supplied: the 'Responses continuation ... not restore native KV state' claim, the MiMo native-owner quarantine, the media-memory refusal mapping, and the audio-rejection ingress ordering. These are documentation assertions only. The threat model may need no update. The head text covers lines 397-1207 only. Line ranges 1239-1264 and 1512-1519 were changed per file_changes but are outside the supplied text, so another pass should check them. I found no concrete security regression.
